summary: A rotation as { w, x, y, z }, with w first in the constructor. Its methods work in radians. Anywhere the API expects a rotation, you can also pass Euler angles in degrees, as { x, y, z } with no w. set, normalize, mul and slerp modify the quaternion and return it.

w.summary: The scalar part. You can assign to it (normalize afterwards to keep it a rotation).

x.summary: The x part. You can assign to it.

y.summary: The y part. You can assign to it.

z.summary: The z part. You can assign to it.

fromEuler.summary: A rotation from Euler angles in radians.

params.roll: Around z (the world's up axis: turning left and right).

fromEuler.exampleLua:
-- a quarter turn around the world's up axis
local facing = kcds.math.Quaternion.fromEuler(0, 0, Math.PI / 2)
npc.rotation = facing

fromAxisAngle.summary: A rotation by an angle around an axis.
fromAxisAngle.exampleLua:
-- A quarter turn to the left around the world's up axis (+Z).
local turn = kcds.math.Quaternion.fromAxisAngle(kcds.math.Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), Math.PI / 2)
npc.rotation = npc.rotation:clone():mul(turn)

clone.example: const before = player.rotation.clone(); // later changes to before leave the player alone
clone.exampleLua: local before = player.rotation:clone() -- later changes to before leave the player alone
clone.exampleCs: var before = player.Rotation.Clone(); // later changes to before leave the player alone

dot.summary: The dot product with another quaternion.
dot.example:
// Near 1 (or -1): the two rotations face almost the same way.
const alike = Math.abs(a.dot(b)) > 0.99;
dot.exampleLua:
-- Near 1 (or -1): the two rotations face almost the same way.
local alike = math.abs(a:dot(b)) > 0.99
dot.exampleCs:
// Near 1 (or -1): the two rotations face almost the same way.
var alike = Math.Abs(a.Dot(b)) > 0.99;

length.summary: Its length (1 for a proper rotation).
length.example:
const facing = player.rotation;
const valid = Math.abs(facing.length - 1) < 1e-6; // a proper rotation has length 1
length.exampleLua:
local facing = player.rotation
local valid = math.abs(#facing - 1) < 1e-6 -- a proper rotation has length 1
length.exampleCs:
var facing = player.Rotation;
var valid = Math.Abs(facing.Length - 1) < 1e-6; // a proper rotation has length 1

normalize.summary: Scales it to length 1 (all zeros gives the identity).

mul.summary: Combines it with another rotation (this, then q, as quaternion product this × q).
mul.example:
// Turn 180 degrees from where the player faces.
const behind = player.rotation.clone().mul(kcds.math.Quaternion.fromEuler(0, 0, Math.PI));
mul.exampleLua:
-- Turn 180 degrees from where the player faces.
local behind = player.rotation:clone():mul(kcds.math.Quaternion.fromEuler(0, 0, Math.PI))
mul.exampleCs:
// Turn 180 degrees from where the player faces.
var behind = player.Rotation.Clone().Mul(Quaternion.FromEuler(0, 0, Math.PI));

conjugate.summary: A new quaternion with x, y and z negated: the opposite rotation of a unit quaternion.
conjugate.example:
const turn = kcds.math.Quaternion.fromEuler(0, 0, Math.PI / 2);
const undo = turn.conjugate(); // turn.clone().mul(undo) is no rotation
conjugate.exampleLua:
local turn = kcds.math.Quaternion.fromEuler(0, 0, Math.PI / 2)
local undo = turn:conjugate() -- turn.clone().mul(undo) is no rotation
conjugate.exampleCs:
var turn = Quaternion.FromEuler(0, 0, Math.PI / 2);
var undo = turn.Conjugate(); // turn.clone().mul(undo) is no rotation

inverse.summary: A new quaternion that undoes this one.
inverse.exampleLua:
local turn = kcds.math.Quaternion.fromEuler(0, 0, Math.PI / 2)
local back = turn:inverse()
local same = back:rotateVector(turn:rotateVector(kcds.math.Vector3.new(1, 0, 0))) -- Vector3(1, 0, 0) again, give or take rounding

slerp.summary: Turns it towards a target along the shortest arc: t = 0 stays, 1 reaches it.
slerp.example:
// Turn a quarter of the way towards the target rotation every tick.
npc.rotation = npc.rotation.clone().slerp(targetRotation, 0.25);
slerp.exampleLua:
-- Turn a quarter of the way towards the target rotation every tick.
npc.rotation = npc.rotation:clone():slerp(targetRotation, 0.25)
slerp.exampleCs:
// Turn a quarter of the way towards the target rotation every tick.
npc.Rotation = npc.Rotation.Clone().Slerp(targetRotation, 0.25);

rotateVector.summary: A new vector: the given one rotated by this (unit) rotation.
rotateVector.exampleLua:
-- The direction a player faces: the world's +Y turned by their rotation.
local facing = player.rotation:rotateVector(kcds.math.Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
local inFront = player.position:clone():add(facing:mul(2))

toEuler.summary: Its Euler angles in radians, as a Vector3 (pitch, yaw, roll).
toEuler.example:
const angles = player.rotation.toEuler(); // radians: Vector3(pitch, yaw, roll)
const headingDegrees = (angles.z * 180) / Math.PI; // turning around the world's up axis
toEuler.exampleLua:
local angles = player.rotation:toEuler() -- radians: Vector3(pitch, yaw, roll)
local headingDegrees = (angles.z * 180) / Math.PI -- turning around the world's up axis
toEuler.exampleCs:
var angles = player.Rotation.ToEuler(); // radians: Vector3(pitch, yaw, roll)
var headingDegrees = (angles.Z * 180) / Math.PI; // turning around the world's up axis

z.example: console.log(kcds.math.Quaternion.fromEuler(0, 0, Math.PI).z); // 1: half a turn around up
z.exampleLua: print(kcds.math.Quaternion.fromEuler(0, 0, Math.PI).z) -- 1: half a turn around up
z.exampleCs: Log.Info(Quaternion.FromEuler(0, 0, Math.PI).Z); // 1: half a turn around up
